description: The line plot titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset" illustrates the performance metrics of a hate speech detection model under various ablation conditions. The x-axis represents different ablation conditions, including "Full model (Ours)," "w/o Prompt," "w/o Augmentation," "w/o Attention," and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation," with the conditions labeled at a 45-degree angle for readability. The y-axis measures the performance metric in percentage, ranging from approximately 56% to 66%. The plot features three lines, each representing a different metric: "Precision," "Recall," and "F1-score." The "Precision" line is marked with circles and a solid line, the "Recall" line with squares and a solid line, and the "F1-score" line with diamonds and a solid line. The "Precision" line starts at 65.78% for the "Full model (Ours)" condition, dips to 59.64% for "w/o Prompt," rises to 63.75% for "w/o Augmentation," peaks at 64.06% for "w/o Attention," and then drops to 59.17% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The "Recall" line begins at 65.56% for the "Full model (Ours)" condition, decreases to 59.64% for "w/o Prompt," increases to 62.63% for "w/o Augmentation," then to 59.67% for "w/o Attention," and finally to 57.74% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." The "F1-score" line starts at 65.45% for the "Full model (Ours)" condition, decreases to 60.16% for "w/o Prompt," increases to 62.22% for "w/o Augmentation," then to 64.06% for "w/o Attention," and finally to 57.74% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation." Data points are annotated with their respective values, providing a clear and precise reference for each metric across the different ablation conditions.
